subject.title: feat(android): copy or save rendered widgets as images from the chat transcript

question: Should Android ship copy/save PNG actions for rendered transcript widgets as part of the supported chat interaction model?
rationale: This is a new user-facing interaction, not a repair of an established Android behavior; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit product decision independent of patch quality.

options.title: Sponsor the Android export flow
options.body: Accept this platform-native interaction and require concise after-fix device proof of the actual long-press menu before merge.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the proposal unmerged until the cross-platform widget-export direction and Android transcript UX are explicitly prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Android export flow
recommendation.body: Accept this platform-native interaction and require concise after-fix device proof of the actual long-press menu before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this person to the Android proposal and its paired platform workstreams, though current-main ownership history could not be independently established.
